cards.card_text: He adds that they have no justification to account for this commotion.
cards.verse_text: For we are in jeopardy of being charged with rioting for today’s events, and we have no justification to account for this commotion.”

cards.verse_text: He was delivered over to death for our trespasses and was raised to life for our justification.

cards.card_text: One trespass brought condemnation for all men, and one act of ___ brought justification and life for all men.
cards.verse_text: So then, just as one trespass brought condemnation for all men, so also one act of righteousness brought justification and life for all men.
